settings.title: How can we help?
settings.subtitle: Everything about your order, our products, sizing, and our mission — in one place. Search below or browse by topic.
settings.no_results_text: No results found. Try a different search term or category.
settings.answer_1: Standard shipping is $6.99, and free on orders $75 and up. Express shipping is $16.99.
settings.answer_2: Orders are processed within 2–5 business days before they ship. During drops or high-volume periods, processing may take slightly longer.
settings.question_3: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer_3: After processing, Standard shipping takes 5–8 business days and Express takes 2–3 business days.
settings.question_4: Do you offer faster / expedited shipping?
settings.answer_4: Yes — Express shipping is available at checkout for $16.99 and arrives in 2–3 business days after processing.
settings.answer_5: Not yet — we currently ship within the United States only. International shipping is on the roadmap. Join our email list to be notified when it opens up.
settings.question_6: How do I track my order?
settings.answer_6: You'll get a shipping confirmation email with tracking info as soon as your order ships. You can also track anytime through the "View your order" link in your order confirmation email.
settings.question_7: My tracking hasn't updated — where's my order?
settings.answer_7: Carriers sometimes take a day or two to scan a package after pickup, so a stalled tracking update doesn't necessarily mean anything's wrong. If it hasn't moved in more than 3 business days, email hello@shopshroud.com and we'll look into it.
settings.question_8: How do I check my order status?
settings.answer_8: Use the "View your order" link in your confirmation email, or log into your account if you created one at checkout.
settings.question_9: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer_9: We start processing orders quickly, so we can't guarantee changes or cancellations once an order is placed. Email hello@shopshroud.com right away and we'll do everything we can if it hasn't started processing yet.
settings.question_10: Can I change my shipping address?
settings.answer_10: Contact us immediately at hello@shopshroud.com. We can usually update an address before an order ships, but can't redirect a package once it's already on its way.
settings.question_11: I received the wrong or a missing item — what do I do?
settings.answer_11: Email hello@shopshroud.com right away so we can make it right.
settings.answer_12: You have 30 days from delivery to request a return. Items must be unworn, unused, with tags attached, and in original packaging.
settings.question_13: How do I start a return or exchange?
settings.answer_13: Email hello@shopshroud.com to request a return. Once approved, we'll send you a shipping label and instructions.
settings.question_14: Can I exchange for a different size or color?
settings.answer_14: We don't currently offer direct exchanges. Return the item you have, and once it's approved, place a new order for the size or color you want — that's the fastest way to get what you're after.
settings.question_15: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer_15: Once we receive and inspect your return, approved refunds are issued to your original payment method within 10 business days.

settings.question_17: How do I find my size?
settings.answer_17: Check the size chart on each product page for exact measurements.
settings.question_18: Are your hoodies and tees unisex?
settings.answer_18: Yes, all Shroud apparel is designed as unisex.

settings.question: How do your sizes fit?
settings.answer: Shroud runs oversized and boxy by design — that's the intended fit, not a mistake. If you want something closer to true-to-size, size down.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Check the size chart on each product page for exact measurements.

settings.question: Are your hoodies and tees unisex?
settings.answer: Yes, all Shroud apparel is designed as unisex.

settings.question: What if I'm between sizes?
settings.answer: Size down for a fit closer to true-to-size, or size up for an even more oversized look.

settings.question: Do any items run cropped or short?
settings.answer: No — everything in the current collection is designed with the same oversized, full-length fit.

settings.question: What are your products made of?
settings.answer: Tees are 6.5oz+ heavyweight cotton (or a cotton/poly blend). Hoodies are 400gsm+ heavyweight fleece.

settings.question: Is the design printed or stitched?
settings.answer: Both, depending on the piece — most graphics are puff print or high-density screen print, and select pieces feature embroidery, noted on each product page.

settings.question: How do I wash and care for it?
settings.answer: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Don't iron directly on the print.

settings.question: Will it shrink?
settings.answer: Minimal shrinkage if you follow the care instructions above — wash cold and avoid high heat.

settings.question: Is the quality actually good?
settings.answer: Every piece is built to survive our own standards test — heavyweight fabric, real print and embroidery techniques, nothing cheap.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: All major credit and debit cards, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

settings.question: Do you have any discounts or promo codes?
settings.answer: Join our email list for 10% off your first order, plus early access to future drops and codes.

settings.question: Do you have a rewards program?
settings.answer: Not yet — it's something we're considering as the community grows.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Yes — checkout is fully encrypted and PCI-compliant through Shopify's secure payment system.

settings.question: What does Shroud stand for?
settings.answer: Shroud means to cover, to protect, to surround. We exist to remind people they're covered by God's grace — clothing with purpose, not just fashion.

settings.question: Where are you based?
settings.answer: Aston Township, Pennsylvania.

settings.question: Are you a Christian company?
settings.answer: Yes. Faith is the foundation of everything we make, not a marketing angle.

settings.question: How do I create an account?
settings.answer: Click "Log in" at the top of the site and select "Create account," or one is created automatically the first time you check out.

settings.question: Can I become an ambassador or affiliate?
settings.answer: We're building this program out — email hello@shopshroud.com if you're interested and we'll follow up as it launches.

settings.question: How do I join your email and text list?
settings.answer: Enter your email (and phone number, for texts) in the signup form at the bottom of any page for 10% off your first order.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders ship within 2-3 business days.
